EX-99.1 2 rgld-20261104xexx991.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 | | | | | | | NEWS RELEASE | Royal Gold Reports Strong Third Quarter Results, Including Record Operating Cash Flow and Gold Equivalent Ounce Sales, Additional Share Repurchases and Full Repayment of Debt after Quarter End DENVER, COLORADO. NOVEMBER 4, 2026: ROYAL GOLD, INC. (NASDAQ: RGLD) (together with its subsidiaries, “Royal Gold,” the “Company,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) released financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 ("third quarter"). "Strong third quarter results extended the positive momentum from the first half of the year,” commented Bill Heissenbuttel, President and CEO of Royal Gold. “Our large and diversified portfolio has generated significant cash flow since we closed the Sandstorm and Horizon transaction in October 2025, allowing us to rapidly pay down debt and rebuild our liquidity. We had $1.225 billion of debt outstanding immediately after closing and initially expected to repay it within two years. Just under one year later, we fully repaid that balance while also funding our regular quarterly dividend, repurchasing shares, and meeting our investment commitments at the Warintza Project. Looking ahead, our portfolio continues to perform well. We remain on track to meet our full-year guidance for gold sales, expect to be at or exceed the top end of our guidance ranges for silver and copper, and we have raised our sales guidance for other metals." Third Quarter Highlights Financial/Operating • Revenue of $464.8 million (compared to $252.1 million in the prior year period) • Revenue split by commodity: 73% gold, 14% silver, 10% copper • Record operating cash flow of $344.4 million (compared to $174.0 million in the prior year period) • Net income of $227.4 million ($2.68 per share), and adjusted net income 1 of $238.3 million ($2.80 per share) (compared to $126.8 million and $136.2 million, respectively, in the prior year period) • Record sales volume of 109,000 GEOs 2 (compared to 72,900 in the prior year period)
